changeSet.author: openelis
changeSet.comment: Historical samples initially lacked a completion marker. Reclassify only records that have no generic-sample data; CUGs are assigned when the order is created and therefore do not indicate completion.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE clinlims.sample_item sample_item SET data_completion_status = 'PENDING_COMPLETION' WHERE data_completion_status = 'COMPLETED' AND quantity IS NULL AND uom_id IS NULL AND collection_date IS NULL AND COALESCE(BTRIM(collector), '') = '' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM clinlims.sample_item_additional_field_value additional_value WHERE additional_value.sample_item_id = sample_item.id AND COALESCE(BTRIM(additional_value.field_value), '') <> '' );
